name: pos-concepts
description: POS artwork concept generation with controlled gradients, opacity and image placement
archetypes: Hero split: dominant full-bleed colour field top two-thirds carrying the headline, calm structured info band below
Type-led poster: headline as the artwork - oversized, tightly cropped typography; minimal supporting elements
Diagonal energy: angled colour panels or shapes driving the eye from headline to call-out; dynamic asymmetry
Framed classic: generous margins, centred composition, thin keyline frame; premium and restrained
Stacked banding: full-width horizontal bands alternating colour/cream; copy lives in its own band; strong rhythm
Corner anchor: visual weight pinned to one corner with copy cascading from it; bold use of empty space
